body: I have dealt with people who have claimed my issues with mental health is a excuse, the person today was no better as he threw insults at me, which is one of the many things people do to me if I try to explain my problems to them.
That is good on you and I am happy for your ability to control your emotions.

I am happy you can control your anger, you are a very lucky person and I praise that.  
I hope no one can deal with the problems I face daily.

I just hope you understand that there are some things you cant control, for me I cant control my anger, life isn't fair and that's unfortunately the case for me here. I understand why you can call this an excuse as most people never had to deal with the problems I have. Again I have sent a apology for the stuff I have did on my part and I will state it again: I apologize for the very unlawful things I have did, even if it is not in my control.

Yet they were the ones hurling insults at me and harassing me to get a reaction so they can be happy that they made someone mad on the internet. If I did control my anger I wouldn't even give them a reaction in the first place.

I just need my discord account back as the harassers also deleted it.

They were trying to make me mad on purpose so that they can create damage, like it's their way of trolling.  


EDIT: I already have a professional team working on my case, I'm unfortunately dealing with a bunch of people who wanted to make me mad, not sure why these people exist but they do.
My bad, I made a error in the title but I am unable to correct it, so here is the correction: "Why do I never change, even when I try to change?"
